heading: Limitations for noncomplying airport noise and access restrictions
lead: Unless the Secretary of Transportation is satisfied that an airport is not imposing an airport noise or access restriction not in compliance with this subchapter, the airport may not—

tree.text: receive money under subchapter I of chapter 471 of this title; or
impose a passenger facility charge under section 40117 of this title.
